Name: Community Kitchen
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/5WsLD08.gif[/img]

[quote]Fetch food for the Junimos to restore the all-new community centre kitchen!

You'll need to get cooking up a storm in order to deliver these bundles on-time:
the recipes come from all-over, including friendship recipes, level-up rewards, and the Queen of Sauce!

With the Kitchen finished, you'll be able to use the cooktop and fridge just like in your farmhouse,
as well as a brand-new completion reward to keep your appetite high!

[i]Bonne chance, chef, et bon appétit![/i][/quote]

It's bigger, it's better, it's the feature that ruined the Love of Cooking with a hundred horrible bugs -- and it's back!
Welcome back to the Community Centre Kitchen, rebuilt from the ground-up, and rewritten from scratch 3 times over.

In order to finish the community centre, you'll now need to finish a whole new area, with unique bundles and rewards.
All new bundles can be completed in year 1 -- so long as you know the recipes!
Finish all bundles for a special surprise that's hopefully a [i]little more fun[/i] than a Copper Pan...
Supports Remixed Bundles, with a set of 3 weird and wonderful new bundles to roll from.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i0R8wKv.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gojFsig.png[/img]﻿ [size=4][b]Requires the Stardew Valley 1.5.5 beta![/b][/size]
If you don't know what this is, bookmark this page and come back when 1.5.5 is officially released.
For the time being, this mod is Android-incompatible.[size=3]
[/size][size=3][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gojFsig.png[/img]﻿ [size=4][b]Make sure everyone has the mod installed before playing multiplayer![/b][/size]
﻿ ﻿All players should use the same Community Centre mods as the host.[/size][size=3]
﻿ ﻿Mod mismatches will likely cause the farmhand to be kicked to the desktop.
[/size][/size][size=3][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gojFsig.png[/img] ﻿﻿[size=4][b]Compatible with most bundle mods![/b][/size]
﻿ ﻿Tested with Challenging Community [/size][size=3]Center Bundles and Vegan Bundles.
﻿ ﻿All custom bundles are added to the world without breaking any others!
[/size][/size][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gojFsig.png[/img]﻿[size=4][b] ﻿Safe to add to existing save files![/b][/size] ﻿(...hopefully!)
﻿ ﻿Savegames with the community centre already completed won't be changed at all.[/size]
﻿ ﻿Savegames with an in-progress CC will need to finish the new bundles before it's complete!
﻿ ﻿Remove the mod at any time to restore the CC to normal and return any donated items.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sH383Pe.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gojFsig.png[/img]﻿ ﻿[size=4][b]Almost the whole mod is fully translated... except for the new dialogue in the i18n folder![/b][/size]
﻿﻿Feel like helping out? Write up [b]i18n/default[/b] in your home language, send me a copy,
﻿﻿and have your name added to our lovely list of translators!
